description: Test definitions for VoicePushToTalk features, focusing on delta computations and attributed color comparisons within the OpenClaw project.

methods.name: delta trims committed prefix
methods.description: Tests the delta calculation when the committed prefix matches the beginning of the current string.

methods.name: delta falls back when prefix differs
methods.description: Tests the delta calculation fallback when the committed prefix does not match the beginning of the current string.

methods.name: attributed colors differ when not final
methods.description: Checks that attributed colors are different when the isFinal flag is false.

methods.name: attributed colors match when final
methods.description: Checks that attributed colors are the same when the isFinal flag is true.
